title: OneDrive: odcli command-line tool for the sync app
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned capabilities and March CY2027 target. Its licensing background is supported by Microsoft Learn, and fresh searches found no odcli-specific documentation resolving the stated control, installation or permission gaps.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a new command-line tool named odcli for the OneDrive sync app.
claims.quote: A new command-line tool, odcli, lets OneDrive users, IT admins and support engineers check and manage the OneDrive sync app from the command line.
